meta.notes: M1 starting numbers (docs/milestones/M1.md): 13 / 6 / 27 ticks and a 30-tick cooldown. Damage is combat-1's [default]. The shove is combat-3's (playtest 1, 2026-09-30: a landed kick pushes the target about a lane width, like a forced swerve): 18 m/s peak, falling to zero over the 0.4 s shove, moves the target 3.6 m at equal mass. The tuning panel's 'Kick shove' and 'Shove length' sliders adjust it.
